name: Zscaler MCP
description: Queries and manages Zscaler ZIA, ZPA, ZDX and other Zero Trust services from AI clients, read-only by default, for security and network admins.

skills.name: ZIA Policy Management
skills.description: Lists and, once write tools are allowlisted, changes Zscaler Internet Access firewall rules, URL filtering, and rule labels.

skills.name: ZPA Application Access
skills.description: Lists and manages Zscaler Private Access application segments and segment groups that control private app access.

skills.name: ZDX Digital Experience
skills.description: Retrieves Zscaler Digital Experience monitoring and analytics data so agents can investigate end-user experience issues.

skills.name: Z-Insights Analytics
skills.description: Queries Z-Insights analytics on web traffic, cyber incidents, and shadow IT across your Zscaler tenant.

skills.name: Guarded Write Operations
skills.description: Keeps the server read-only until write tools are allowlisted, and confirms every delete with a human prompt or signed token.
